item.title: Getting Here
item.description:
RGUHack is held in the Sir Ian Wood Building on the RGU Garthdee Campus in Aberdeen

The Sir Ian Wood Building, Robert Gordon University, Garthdee Rd, Aberdeen AB10 7GJ

Getting to the campus is easy, either using the No. 1 or 2 Bus routes from Union St which is a 5-10 min walk from Aberdeen Train and Bus Station

What do I need to bring?
